text: Phone Learning Path is one page like the reference image: the module as a drop-down card with its progress, then the units as drop-downs (the current unit open to its lessons). Tapping a lesson opens its overview as a popover; What you'll gain in a unit opens the unit's objectives as a popover. Names only.
rationale: Chris, 2026-10-08, with a reference image: closer to this, use drop menus where it makes sense, tap loads the unit what-you-gain popover and/or lesson overviews. Supersedes the three-level phone default
